params.name: Input
params.description: The geometry that passes through with a time detail attribute added.

params.name: Attribute
params.description: Name of the detail attribute written with the 0 to 1 progress through the frame range. Empty writes nothing.

params.name: Start Frame
params.description: The frame at which the attribute reads 0.

params.name: End Frame
params.description: The frame at which the attribute reads 1. If equal to Start Frame, it jumps from 0 to 1 at that frame.

params.name: Clamp
params.description: When true the value stays between 0 and 1 outside the range. When false it keeps running, below 0 before the start and above 1 after the end.
